summary: Automation graphs: built-in nodes notify (users, groups, roles and trigger-event participants, channels, level) and send_to_contact (phone or email of a record) in pkg/automation/builtin/notify, both effects that queue the notice with notifications.AudienceSender.SendTx in the step transaction under the automations.notify.v1 definition (notify.Contribute); the engine gains effect nodes that pick an outcome (OutcomeEffectNode), dry-run previews (EffectPreviewer, DryRunOptions.Preview), node graph rules (GraphChecker), StepContext.NodeID/Trigger/StepKey.
